$comment: Vendor-engine exceptions for the TASK-OSS-P5-03 browser matrix. An entry removes one {engine, condition} cell from the lane and MUST say why, at which engine version it was observed, and when it was last re-checked. A blanket skip is not an exception -- it is the lane narrowing without saying so, which is the failure this file exists to prevent.
method: Each {engine, condition} pair was opened with the context options the matrix uses, and the corresponding media query was read back from the page. See the handoff in docs/program-2026-08/EXECUTION-STATUS.md.

chromium.touch: (pointer: coarse) resolves true with hasTouch + isMobile

firefox.touch: (pointer: coarse) resolves true with hasTouch + isMobile -- isMobile IS accepted at 1.61.1, contrary to older guidance

webkit.forced-colors: (forced-colors: active) resolves true -- forcedColors IS accepted at 1.61.1, contrary to older guidance. Note this emulates the media feature; it does not install a system palette, so a spec must assert that an indicator survives rather than that it takes a system color.
